quote: IFC… and IDB Invest… announced a US$13.5 million investment in projects by Solengy Haiti S.A.… The project aims to support the installation of 10 MWp of solar PV and 20 MWh of storage… Structured by IFC, the long-term financing package consists of a US$3 million senior loan from IFC’s own account, a US$3 million senior loan mobilized by IDB Invest, a US$6 million subordinated loan from the Canada-IFC Blended Climate Finance Program, and a US$1.5 million grant from the Korea Green, Resilient and Innovative Development (K-GRID) program.
